title: Tool card sheets don't reopen after dismissing a sheet
description: In ToolsView, after opening and then closing a tool sheet (e.g., closing Traceroute via the close button which calls dismiss()), subsequent clicks on other tool cards fail to open their sheets. The onTapGesture on ToolCard sets selectedTool but the .sheet(item:) binding appears stuck. Only resolved by app restart. This is likely a SwiftUI state management issue where selectedTool doesn't properly reset to nil after sheet dismissal, or a timing issue with the sheet(item:) modifier.
close_reason: Fixed: replaced .sheet(item:) with isPresented binding pattern to prevent stale state

title: Traceroute tool fails with Operation not permitted in App Sandbox
description: The Traceroute tool in ToolsView fails with 'Command failed (exit -1): The operation couldn't be completed. Operation not permitted' when trying to run /usr/sbin/traceroute. This is because traceroute requires raw socket access which is blocked by the App Sandbox. Need to either: (a) use an alternative approach like UDP-based traceroute via Network.framework, or (b) show a user-friendly error explaining the limitation for sandboxed apps.
close_reason: Fixed: improved error message for traceroute sandbox permission failure
